name: Őcsény (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of red and blue at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Őcsény: a light blue and red shield with birds, a bunch of grapes, a tree, a ploughshare and bars, inscribed ŐCSÉNY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
